info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Checkouts-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Checkout API allows users to access and list current parking reservation checkouts. This endpoint provides essential information related to reservations that are in the checkout state, enabling businesses to manage their parking services effectively. Developers can integrate this API to monitor ongoing transactions and user parking needs, making it a vital tool for parking management systems. Typical consumers include businesses in the parking industry, fleet management services, and mobile parking applications, who can leverage this data for operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve checkout details for a reservation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain the necessary checkout details for their reservations. It includes information on payment, guest information, and any additional requirements to complete the booking process.
